::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Cisco invested $150 million to expand its Bengaluru facility into a full chip design centre. India teams contribute to networking ASIC design for enterprise and data centre switches and routers.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Networking ASIC design, verification, and physical design for Cisco's switching and routing platforms. Bengaluru is being expanded to support full chip design capabilities.
